source.adjustment: F20 residualization and population residual-SD division within each posterior draw
source.estimator: posterior mean of within-draw sample mean violation severities; I = 1 - V/V0
source.points: Posterior means, rounded to four decimals and independently shuffled within each pair
source.ranking: max(0, forward I) minus max(0, converse I), with highest-forward-I tie-break
